newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index falls 0.67 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index falls 0.67 pct.

text.p: Perth stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index fell 0.67 percent in the week to Thursday. The All Ordinaries Index rose 1.30 percent.
Mar 27 Mar 20 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.
The Eyres Reed Explorers Index fell 23.7 points in subdued trade, affected by the shortened trading week and spooked by broader market uncertainty, Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said.
Falls outnumbered rises by a ratio of four to three.
Strong performances included Cambridge Gulf, up eight cents to 43 cents, Platgold, up 1.5 cents to 9.5 cents, Capricorn three cents better at 36.5 cents and Money Mining, up four cents to 31 cents.

Falls included Arboyne, down three cents to 27 cents, Helix off 22 cents to A$2.60, Goldstream four cents lower at 52 cents, Triton off two cents to 15.5 cents and General Gold off three cents to 26.5 cents.

Nervousness in "spec" resources seemed set to continue in the absence of many exploration results and the likely fallout from the Canadian resources sector following the news that there are grave doubts about the authenticity of the size of the Indonesian Busang gold deposit which is controlled by the North Americans Bre-X and Freeport-McMoran, Colgan added.
